value.rationale: Stable H2 order reduction uses stationary pole solvers whose roots need not be globally optimal. This is the minimal nontrivial natural symmetric two-mode family, and it has a complete globally complex-admissible phase diagram, exact emergence of two best models, strict saddle witness, and closed-form error penalty for the symmetric stationary candidate. It is a precise analytic diagnostic/benchmark for choosing and testing stable reduction initializations, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a generic existence statement.
